archetypes.name: shell-compat
archetypes.rationale: The project has a hard Bash 3.2 portability requirement (BASH_AUTHORING.md), and the new probe code introduces several constructs that deserve explicit scrutiny against that forbidden list.
archetypes.prompt_body: Audit `scripts/check-reviewers.sh` and `scripts/test-check-reviewers.sh` strictly against the Bash 3.2 compatibility rules in `BASH_AUTHORING.md`. Check for forbidden constructs: `declare -A`/`declare -n`/`local -n`, `mapfile`/`readarray`, `${var^^}`/`${var,,}`, `&>>`, `coproc`. Verify that `printf -v` (Bash 3.1+), `(( ))` arithmetic, `${arr[@]+"${arr[@]}"}` empty-array guards, and `SECONDS` builtin reset are all valid in Bash 3.2. Confirm that the `case`-based env-var normalization pattern replaces any 4+-only constructs. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
